answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one onyx weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, a hostile operator who spins up 33 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 74 times the capital for one share. The harbor report shows the merge explicitly at each lotus. A farm of 3298 identities would post 4121 proofs and burn roughly 6 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
